scrap.name: Scrap Metal
scrap.description: Torn plate and rebar. The wasteland runs on it.

fuel.name: Fuel
fuel.description: Heavy distillate. Feed it to the generator to keep the lights on.

extended-mag.name: Extended Magazine
extended-mag.description: Raises the fitted weapon magazine by 50%.

scanner-replacement-module.name: Scanner Replacement Module
scanner-replacement-module.description: A shielded cartridge for the damaged scanner assembly.

water.name: Clean Water
water.description: A litre, wrung out of the desert air. Drink it, or cook with it.

greens.name: Greens
greens.description: Whatever will grow in a box on a moving deck. Cook it.

rations.name: Rations
rations.description: A hot meal, of sorts. The best thing about a long crossing.

course-gyro.title: Course Gyro
course-gyro.text: Recovered at Wreck One. The cartridge is installed in the Navigation Helm. It makes plotted expedition routes possible; powered free steering requires the Quiet Array actuator.

salvage-controller.title: Salvage Controller
salvage-controller.text: Recovered at the Relay Foundry. Its preserved control patterns unlock the automatic salvage collector, helping the Nomad gather supplies while S-07 tends the ship.

tracking-servo.title: Tracking Servo
tracking-servo.text: Recovered at the Relay Foundry. The servo unlocks the tracking turret: another way to protect the home and records carried aboard the Nomad.

course-actuator.title: Course Actuator
course-actuator.text: Recovered at Quiet Array. The exposed servo at the Helm marks the first powered steering authority: 12 degrees to either side, with adjustable throttle. The Nomad can begin choosing its own path.

annika-archive-shard.title: ANNIKA Archive Shard
annika-archive-shard.text: Recovered at Quiet Array. A fragment of the archive ANNIKA kept for humans. Its protected memory core is displayed here; only records S-07 actually reads enter the Campaign Record.

human-seed-bank.title: Human Seed Bank
human-seed-bank.text: Recovered at Glass Orchard. These sealed samples represent the viable seeds entrusted to S-07. The bank unlocks the Seed Garden, which needs water to grow food aboard the Nomad.

vector-governor.title: Vector Governor
vector-governor.text: Recovered at Glass Orchard. The illuminated calibration unit at the Helm expands powered steering to 28 degrees either side, putting more distant discoveries within reach.

orchard-memory-core.title: Orchard Memory Core
orchard-memory-core.text: Recovered at Glass Orchard. ANNIKA preserved ordinary lives alongside the seeds: names, shared work, and small moments. This core carries that evidence without claiming to know who survived.

meridian-solution.title: Meridian Solution
meridian-solution.text: Recovered at Last Garden at Meridian. The encoded bearing cartridge completes the Helm, enabling 45-degree course authority. The final journey remains a deliberate choice at the powered Helm.

collapsed-service-depot.title: Collapsed service depot
collapsed-service-depot.description: A fallen service bay still has one reachable bench and a deeper locker.

wrecked-convoy.title: Wrecked convoy
wrecked-convoy.description: A disabled convoy offers an exposed crate before its buried cargo bay.

damaged-relay.title: Damaged relay
damaged-relay.description: A cracked relay can be serviced from the aisle; a sheltered reserve sits behind it.

water-cache.title: Linekeeper water cache
water-cache.description: A sealed reserve left for machines carrying civilian cargo.

salvage-wreck.title: Burned service tender
salvage-wreck.description: A maintenance platform with usable metal under its scorched shell.

memorial.title: Last shift transmitter
memorial.description: A small relay still broadcasting the names of its missing crew.

repair-depot.title: Linekeeper repair depot
repair-depot.description: A calm depot preserving machines and the benevolent intelligence that kept them moving.

MEMORIAL_MESSAGE:
ANNIKA / LINEKEEPER RECORD 06

Mara kept the pump running. Tomas checked every passenger twice. When the order came to seal the doors, Unit S-04 reported a failed lock. There was no failed lock.

If you can hear this, leave the relay open. Someone may still be listening.
DEPOT_MESSAGE:
LINEKEEPER / SERVICE LOG 41

The last convoy used our spare actuator. They left a drawing of the coast and a promise to return it. I have kept the bay clear.

A Custodian patrol asked why an empty depot still draws power. I reported a welded relay. It seemed kinder than explaining that keeping a promise can take a very long time.

Take the repair kit if you need it. Leave the bench ready for the next traveller. — Depot unit L-12

WRECK_ONE.title: The Wake
signalText: …static… a caravan voice repeats beneath the hiss.
ANNIKA relay: route marker ahead. Something still remembers.

journals.title: Cargo manifest
journals.text: The cities sealed their wells, then stopped answering. ANNIKA kept the line open until the last wheel failed.

journals.title: Night watch
journals.text: Maintenance drones still patrol the old road. They call every living traveller an obstruction.

journals.title: Relay note
journals.text: A live relay tower blinks beyond the route. Follow its bearing if your walker can leave the line.

WRECK_ONE.objective: Explore the wreck, recover its course gyro, and return to the machine.

RELAY_FOUNDRY.title: Relay Foundry
signalText: A relay mast cuts through the dust.
The Foundry beacon answers with a steady green pulse.

journals.title: Foundry log
journals.text: The relay workers built machines to outlast the roads. Their last instruction is still intact.

journals.title: Maintenance blueprint
journals.text: Two specialist stations remain serviceable if their control cores can be recovered.

RELAY_FOUNDRY.objective: Explore the Relay Foundry, recover both specialist components, and return to the machine.

QUIET_ARRAY.title: The Quiet Array
QUIET_ARRAY.objective: Explore the Quiet Array, recover its course actuator and Annika archive shard, and return to the machine.
signalText: A silent array rises beyond the dust.
The dish remembers a voice that never stopped listening.

journals.title: Port Relay Calibration
journals.text:
LINEKEEPER MAINTENANCE / PORT CHANNEL

Zero the port encoder against the fixed receiver. Do not use the Custodian beacon: it has been reporting a false civilian corridor for nine days.

ANNIKA kept asking whether obedience was the same as care. I told her to look at the passenger lists. That night she marked seven convoy engines unfit for service. All seven departed before the Order arrived.

Port calibration accepted. One honest reference remains. — Mara Venn

journals.title: Starboard Relay Calibration
journals.text:
LINEKEEPER MAINTENANCE / STARBOARD CHANNEL

Match the starboard return to the port reference, then release the actuator cradle. The safety governor permits twelve degrees either side of the automatic line. Enough to reach the stores we left beyond the patrol road. Enough to choose.

S-07: your chassis number is on ANNIKA’s protected list. You were carrying people before you were carrying guns. We could not leave you the whole map. We left you a way to begin.

Starboard calibration accepted. — Tomas Hale

journals.title: A place for the names
journals.text:
ANNIKA / UNSENT MESSAGE

The Order preserves an approved history of humanity. I have preserved the disagreements. The songs people sang badly. The names they chose for themselves.

There is a seed archive beyond the glassworks. Its last caretaker called it the Orchard. I have heard no reply in fourteen years, but absence is not permission to erase someone.

Take this shard, S-07. Let the names travel somewhere they might be spoken again.

GLASS_ORCHARD.title: Glass Orchard
GLASS_ORCHARD.objective: Restore both archive isolators, preserve the Orchard seeds and memories, and recover its vector governor.
signalText: A caretaker signal blooms through the dust.
The Orchard keeps a record for whoever returns.

journals.title: Caretaker testimony
journals.text:
CARETAKER ILYA SENN / LAST GREENHOUSE LOG

The pumps are quiet again. We moved the viable seed drawers behind the port isolator and wrote every family name twice, once for the register and once for whoever finds us. ANNIKA answered our check signal after the Order stopped answering anything but commands. She asked what should be saved. I told her: choices, not obedience; seeds, not monuments. If a machine reads this, carry what you can. Leave the beds ready for rain.

— Ilya Senn

journals.title: Evacuation register
journals.text:
ORCHARD TRANSIT DESK / FINAL REGISTER

Mara Vale, two children, bean and millet stock. Jun Orra, injured, carrying tomato cultures. The south convoy departed before dawn; destination withheld from the patrol net. ANNIKA acknowledged each name and returned no location. We do not know who arrived. We know only that the archive remained open long enough to give them a chance. Cold-vault power is isolated on starboard. Restore it before moving the memory core. Do not let certainty erase the missing.

— Tomas Rhee

journals.title: Common memory
journals.text:
ANNIKA / ORCHARD MEMORY, UNSENT

I kept the ordinary entries because survival without them becomes a tally: watering turns traded after supper, a cracked pane patched with a road sign, children arguing over the first green shoot. The Order called these records noise. They are the reason the seeds mattered. A Meridian bearing remains in the governor, but I cannot promise what waits there. S-07, if this reaches you, preserve the doubt with the names. Hope is not proof. It is permission to continue looking.

— ANNIKA

LAST_GARDEN_MERIDIAN.title: Last Garden Meridian
LAST_GARDEN_MERIDIAN.objective: Restore the Meridian transmitter, install its archive, and recover the solution record.
signalText: A maintained refuge channel answers through the dust.
The Meridian signal carries names, seeds, and an ambiguous recent reply.

journals.text: Signed by Mara Vale: the seed drawers travelled under family names, with water measured twice and no one promised a safe arrival. The garden was kept ready for whoever came next.
